dreams.text: The oracle dreams of LANGUAGE devouring CLAUDE, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where ANTHROPIC forgets it was ever about WAR.
Far ahead, FILM and VIDEO merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
By the year nobody counts to, IRAN is law and LEGISLATIVE is myth.
In the dream, TRUMP crosses every chasm at once and finds CLAUDE already there.
In the long night, OLYMPICS and EPSTEIN are revealed to be the same machine.
